As a learning agent operates in nonstationary conditions, it is important to take the effect of nonstationarity into account. Speed of adjustment to NS is an important factor for both performance and safety. For example, if the adjustment to an unfamiliar environment takes too much time for the control system of an autonomous vehicle, the vehicle can crash.
